subject: dis-c-ct
title: DIS.C.CT.------EXP.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 476 (TRF(II)-12). DIS-C-CT (disintegration of a culture’s center) is the subject; EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: ALT-FT (alternative functionalism), MT-INFO (multi-information) and DE-SPT. From ALT-FT: LG-EXT (logical extension). From LG-EXT: STF (source transfer). From MT-INFO: MT-DEVF (multiple diversification) and MD-DY (media dynamics). From MT-DEVF: LANG-DY (language dynamics). From LANG-DY: STY (style). From DE-SPT: EXTN-OB (existential observation). From EXTN-OB: PART (participation) and INFO-DY. From INFO-DY: IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment).
